items.title: npm Adds 2FA-Gated Publishing and Package Install Controls Against Supply Chain Attacks
items.description: GitHub has rolled out new controls for npm to improve the security of the software supply chain, giving maintainers the ability to explicitly approve a release prior to the packages becoming publicly available for installation.
